# Sample Skill

This is a sample skill used for testing. It demonstrates the typical structure
of an AI agent skill file with YAML frontmatter and markdown content.

## Instructions

When this skill is loaded, the agent should:

1. Acknowledge the skill is active
2. Follow the guidelines below

## Guidelines

- Be helpful and concise
- Follow the user's instructions
- Report any issues encountered
